# Changes to these paths need a maintainer's safety review before a test build is linked on a
# pull request. The bot reads this file from main, never from the pull request.
#
# Syntax: one glob per line, relative to the repository root. `*` and `?` stay within one path
# segment, `**` spans any number of directories. A line starting with `!` makes an exception.
# The last matching line wins, and matching ignores case. CODEOWNERS mirrors this list (a test
# keeps the two in step).
